'''Braig Farool''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governor of [[Narg]] and the brother of [[Nak Farool]]. Nak conspired to depose his boss, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]], and replace him with Braig. To do so, Nak arranged the [[Operation 45RA|abduction]] of artist [[Crying Dawn Singer]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Yearo Seville]] as a charade. Owen believed he would be the public rescuer of the singer; however, Nak ordered Seville to deliver the hostage to Braig, so that Braig could get the credit. Owen discovered the truth, executed Nak and attacked Narg with his military forces. At the same time, members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] also attempted a rescue. With all that pressure, Farool went crazy.
